decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting remains close to the firm's specialist, standards-driven and application-specific knowledge base, so continued learning and refinement make withdrawal unlikely.
The spring-balanced desk lamp still fits the firm's ergonomic office-lighting capabilities, but because it is more peripheral to the core broad-solution strategy it retains a moderate pruning risk.
As a flagship pendant luminaire aligned with the firm's move toward high-quality intelligent interior lighting, it is strongly supported by existing know-how and strategic commitment.

The marine HMI searchlight benefits from related marine and specialist-lighting expertise, but its weaker fit with the firm's LED- and sustainability-oriented trajectory keeps review risk comparatively high.
The marine searchlight continues to build on the firm's established competence in robust certified lighting for demanding environments, supporting retention and incremental improvement.
